title: Greek Lemon Oregano Chicken Thighs with Roast Potatoes
summary: Juicy chicken thighs are roasted with lemon, garlic and oregano, alongside crisp golden potatoes. It’s a simple Greek-style dinner with bright, herby flavour and an easy one-pan feel.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the potato wedges and red onion in a roasting tray, then toss with half the olive oil, 1 teaspoon of the salt, half the black pepper and half the oregano.
Roast the potatoes and onion for 20 minutes so they start turning golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice, garlic, remaining olive oil, remaining oregano, remaining salt, remaining black pepper and paprika in a bowl. Add the chicken thighs and coat well.
Take the tray from the oven, nestle the chicken thighs among the potatoes, and pour over any remaining marinade. Add the lemon wedges to the tray.
Return to the oven and roast for 30 to 35 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, the skin is browned, and the potatoes are crisp and tender.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving, spooning the pan juices over the chicken and potatoes.
